research_method: For each meaningful reasoning round, freeze approximately 4-8 independent evidence-backed source/context hypotheses with machine-level predictions and falsifiers; use fewer when sequential evidence is needed. Run tools/research_batch.py, group effective outputs with fixups/context intact, compare to oracle, parent and siblings, then adapt. Do not spend a quota on cosmetic variants.
promotion: Research-only outputs cannot authorize acceptance. Exact candidates require reviewed complete contribution, fixups/relocations, native grinder attempt and serialized promotion, independent whole-image validation. No object trimming, byte patches, invented padding or relaxed binding.
